body_html:
The Global Solo guest chair brings quiet confidence to any reception area or waiting room. Its contoured seat and back and waterfall seat edge keep visitors comfortable through long waits, while the durable steel sled-base frame and urethane armcaps stand up to the daily traffic of busy clinics, offices and institutional lobbies.

Features

  • Sled-base armchair built on a durable steel round-tube frame
  • Contoured seat and back with a waterfall seat edge for extended comfort
  • Urethane-finished armcaps that resist scuffing and clean up easily
  • Low-back guest profile suited to reception, waiting and meeting areas
  • Wide selection of fabric and vinyl upholstery options over a standard black frame
  • Ships fully assembled and ready to place

Specifications

Overall dimensions are 24"W x 25"D x 34"H, with a 26.5" arm height and an 18" seat height, rated to 300 lbs. Backed by Global's limited lifetime warranty on the frame and components, 12 years on control mechanisms, and 5 years on upholstery, foam and mesh.

Designed and made in Canada by Global Furniture Group. Brant Business Interiors is a family-owned dealer in Peterborough, Ontario serving institutions since 1964, and an OECM-eligible supplier — so Ontario school boards, hospitals and municipalities can buy without an open tender. Call 1-800-835-9565 or Request a Quote for volume pricing on waiting room chairs in Canada.
